name: suggestion-agent

dependencies.name: library-api
dependencies.description: Fetch the catalog of currently available books to suggest from.

description: Reads a member's free-text mood description and the catalog of available books from library-api, and returns two or three suggested books, each with a one-line reason. Does not browse the whole catalog on the member's behalf for any other purpose, does not create or modify loans, and does not answer questions about the member's own loans — that is loan-agent's job.
